original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Read the gzip-container reproducibility examples and distinguish frozen source bytes from regenerated payloads.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Repair silent omission of unreadable unlisted source subtrees in selected-record preflight, preserving both manifest formats and contained-file aliases in an opt-in successor.
scope_change_reason: The drawn card audits generated-payload completeness. The same omission mechanism reproduces at the selected source-authentication boundary, which checks a different object and must reject extra unlisted sources. This is verifier coverage, not a multiplication mechanism advance.
bottleneck_link: Reliable source closure prevents an incomplete preflight from being mistaken for binding of the full selected supplier package. No recursive cost or kappa changes.
stop_rule: Stop after one reproduced completeness defect, the bounded traversal repair, complete inherited regressions and meaningful filesystem controls. Stop without adoption if preserving pinned consumers requires a wider migration.
evidence: python3.12 -I -B research/selected-inventory-fail-closed/verify.py; 59 groups, including 26 unchanged groups per engine, seven new groups, actual CLI permission fixtures and twelve injected traversal failures.
author: Nick Petalas
review_status: Author-checked; no independent human review claimed.
method: Exact pinned predecessor execution with only package_files replaced; deterministic regressions, real unprivileged CLI fixtures and injected open/iteration/metadata failures.
domain: Both supported manifest layouts on stable local filesystems; at most 1000000 descendants per package, including directories. Regular contained file aliases remain supported; directory links and special files are rejected.
milestone: Verifier coverage repair, not supplier admission.

overlap.coverage: Complete remote pagination reported by find_overlap.py; README, TASK and ledger search. No arbitrary code-diff coverage or novelty guarantee.

nearest.delta: Generated-payload comparator inventory, not selected-record source closure.
Selected-preflight path reuse; retains the original rglob traversal and its access-error omission.
Contained-file aliases and directory-link closure; retained and replayed, not replaced by a no-symlinks contract.
Primary-proof coverage guards retained and replayed.

submission_checkpoint.guidance_change: AGENTS adds archival acceptance versus mathematical endorsement guidance. Read and retained; task catalogue, selected record and pinned runtime sources are unchanged. Preserve the original scientific/source baseline.
submission_checkpoint.overlap: 452 open PRs, 2184 closed PRs and 1638 discussion/comment records; complete pagination reported, no warnings. PR2921 and PR2793 remain explicitly distinguished.

limitations: Production checker and byte-pinned consumers remain unchanged; adoption needs explicit migration review.
No atomic snapshot, concurrent-writer protection, malicious filesystem defense or universal resource bound.
No complete selected cold replay, new supplier, new kappa or hosted CI result.

open_questions.question: Should the selected-record production checker adopt this inventory boundary?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The opt-in successor closes the demonstrated omission, but the default preflight still uses the retained traversal.
open_questions.first_step: Review the traversal delta and migrate selected-binding-coverage-seeda342 and selected-dependency-heads-audit to an explicit accepted successor, then replay their source-bound checks.
open_questions.blocked_by: Production source-pin compatibility and maintainer adoption review; no mathematical supplier change is required.
